title: Transactional row-14 owner capacity protocol
objective: Replace the resumable class-group root owner-growth stop with field-neutral transactional required-capacity reporting, qualify undersized and bounded prefix progression for the frozen row-14 quartic sentinel, and proceed toward exact completion only below 4 GiB.

oracles: Frozen row-14 oracle payload/prepared/event/terminal hashes supplied by the integration audit
GMP/tagged differential replay with one-slot-short no-mutation checks

handoff.summary: Added a source-transparent 32-slot relation-owner capacity report, entry preflight, and derived reports at every later -204 frontier. Frozen row 14 authenticates all supplied hashes and passes exact/one-slot-short/no-write qualification on CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged backends under a 4 GiB address-space ceiling. The initial report derives 799 rows, target 806, PARI init_rel reserve 8110, and 7,207,387 scalar cells without fixture constants.
risks: The root ABI gains one trailing capacity_state buffer, so integration adapters that construct the old positional ABI must append it.

Only an entry miss is byte-for-byte transactional for all retained owners. Later misses occur after private scratch mutation; callers must discard those owners and restart from authenticated prepared nfinit.

This lane qualifies the capacity gate, not the final 806-relation/HNF [24, 8]/class-number-192 result. Integer word-capacity requirements for the full integrated root remain to be measured below 4 GiB.
The focused 4 GiB checker is recorded. Broad pnpm test:baselib:strict and pnpm test:native validation is intentionally deferred to the integration lane.
next_steps: Teach the integration adapter to allocate every owner from capacity_state and restart the root from prepared nfinit after any later capacity miss.
Run the authentic row-14 root with measured per-owner limb capacities; if it approaches 4 GiB, pack or reuse relation-record storage instead of increasing the acceptance ceiling.
Compare the resulting relation progression, HNF/SNF, compact units, regulator, maps, and sealed envelope to the frozen oracle only after computation completes.
